crossRefs.note: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Mysia
people.line: A region in northwest Asia Minor visited by Paul

translations.web: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
translations.bsb: And when they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not permit them.
translations.kjv: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
translations.asv: and when they were come over against Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia; and the Spirit of Jesus suffered them not;
